ops.sql: SELECT d.DocID, p.Name AS PackageName, d.DocName, d.Version, d.DocDate, LENGTH(d.BinContent) AS bytes, LENGTH(d.BinContent) / 1048576.0 AS mb FROM t_document d JOIN t_package p ON p.ea_guid = d.ElementID WHERE d.DocType = 'Baseline' AND p.Name LIKE 'FBT-CAL%' ORDER BY d.DocDate
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(LENGTH(BinContent)) / 1048576.0 AS mb_total FROM t_document WHERE DocType = 'Baseline'
